finance_menus.goal: See balances, upcoming work, attention and cross-domain financial health.
Keep cash/bank balances correct and execute receipts/payments/transfers.
Collect and clear amounts due to the company.
Pay valid obligations on time while preserving cash/control.
Recognize costs in the correct period and clear/reverse liabilities.
Recognize prepaid costs over time and liquidate advances.
Keep HO/unit due-from/due-to and principal balances mirrored and settled.
Ensure operational quantity/cost valuation agrees with financial inventory and BDP.
Monitor sales, discount, returns, COGS and margin from operational sources.
Control asset/project capitalization, schedules, NBV, OE replacement and disposal.
Track tax credits/liabilities, reconcile returns and execute payments.
Control debt, interest, current maturity and equity movements.
Protect ledger integrity and period finalization.
Read and drill into TB, BS, P&L, cash flow, aging and unit/consolidated reports.

page_archetypes.goal: Drive outstanding balance to a resolved state.
Make expected/subledger balance equal actual/GL balance.
Recognize the correct amount in the correct period.
Keep financial object state and carrying amount correct across its life.
Detect changes, trends and exceptions without creating duplicate transactions.
Maintain ledger integrity and controlled judgement entries.
Keep custody balances accurate and reconciled.
Surface expense impact through the source object rather than a standalone expense transaction module.

coding_contract.purpose: Resolve semantic role + dimensions + unit into actual leaf account.
coding_contract.minimum_schema: account_role_binding(role, dimension_kind, dimension_value, unit, account_code10, account_code12, valid_from, valid_to)
coding_contract.rule: Business logic references semantic roles, never hard-codes 12-digit unit accounts.

coding_contract.minimum_schema: business_event(id, type, source_domain, source_id, unit, occurred_at, payload_json, idempotency_key, status)
coding_contract.rule: One source transaction/event must be idempotent and traceable.

coding_contract.purpose: Translate event + stage + context into journal lines.
coding_contract.minimum_schema: posting_rule(id, event_type, scope, condition_json, mode, status, version); posting_rule_line(rule_id, seq, side, role, dimension_expr, amount_expr)
coding_contract.rule: Posting is selected by event/stage/context, not by account alone.

coding_contract.minimum_schema: journal(id, event_id, posting_rule_version, date, unit, status, reversed_by); journal_line(journal_id, account_id, debit, credit, dimensions_json)
coding_contract.rule: Posted journal is immutable; corrections use reverse + repost.

coding_contract.purpose: Common lifecycle for receivable, payable, accrual, advance.
coding_contract.minimum_schema: open_item(id, type, source_id, counterparty, original_amount, outstanding_amount, due_date, status, expected_next_event)
coding_contract.rule: Settlement actions reduce outstanding; support partial settlement.

coding_contract.purpose: Single cash movement object reused across Payables/Accruals/Receivables/Cash & Bank.
coding_contract.minimum_schema: cash_movement(id, kind, source_object_type, source_object_id, cash_account_role, amount, date, status, reference)
coding_contract.rule: One payment may appear in multiple views but creates one transaction.

coding_contract.purpose: Prepaid recognition, depreciation, amortization, recurring accrual/reversal.
coding_contract.minimum_schema: schedule(id, type, source_id, start_date, end_date, frequency, method, total, remaining, next_run, status)
coding_contract.rule: Each run is idempotent and links to generated journal.

coding_contract.minimum_schema: reconciliation(id, type, period, expected_total, actual_total, difference, status); match(id, reconciliation_id, left_ref, right_ref, amount, confidence, status)
coding_contract.rule: Matching itself need not create a journal unless an adjustment/settlement event occurs.

coding_contract.purpose: Generate durable work items for overdue/mismatch/missed expected events.
coding_contract.minimum_schema: attention(id, rule_key, object_type, object_id, severity, opened_at, due_at, status, assigned_to)
coding_contract.rule: Rules evaluate financial objects, not GL rows only.

coding_contract.minimum_schema: approval(id, object_type, object_id, step, actor, decision, timestamp); audit_event(id, object_type, object_id, action, actor, before_json, after_json)
coding_contract.rule: Payment, write-off, journal, disposal, close can have configurable thresholds.
